defaults.style_prompt: Render as a grounded Victorian location photograph while preserving every recognizable object silhouette from the game frame. Improve materials, lighting, grime, patina, lens realism, and fine texture, but keep furniture, props, doorways, signs, stairs, railings, windows, wall breaks, floor boundaries, and walkable geometry in the same positions. Avoid fantasy embellishment, new readable text, decorative inventions, and rearranged architecture.
